profile.grammar_notes: Agglutinative, SOV, vowel harmony (2- and 4-way). No articles; bir works as indefinite. Identity: personal copula suffixes (-(y)Im, -sIn, -DIr…), zero copula in 3sg; past copula idi/-(y)DI. Existence and possession: var / yok with possessive suffixes (Benim arabam var). Negation: değil for nouns/adjectives, -mA- on verbs, yok for existence. Yes/no questions with the mI particle (written separately, harmonizes). Cases: accusative -(y)I, dative -(y)A, locative -DA, ablative -DAn, genitive -(n)In. Pronouns are often dropped; sen vs siz marks politeness. Want: istemek; can: -(y)Abil-; must: -mAlI / lazım / gerek. Closed sets: personal pronouns (ben, sen, o, biz, siz, onlar), var/yok, evet/hayır, demonstratives bu/şu/o, question words.
